arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ دَيْن تُخْلِقُ بِهِ وَجْهِي، وَيَحَارُ فِيهِ ذِهْنِي، وَيَتَشَعَّبُ لَهُ فِكْرِي، وَيَطُولُ بِمُمَارَسَتِهِ شُغْلِي،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa hab liyal-'afiyah min daynin tukhliq bihi wajhi wa yahāru fīhi dhinī, wa yatashahhabu lahū fikrī wayatuulu bimumaarasatihi shughli
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and release me from a debt which makes me lose face, confuses my mind, disrupts my thinking, and prolongs my occupation with attending to it!

arabic_text: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمِّ الدَّيْنِ وَفِكْرِهِ، وَشُغْلِ الدَّيْنِ وَسَهَرِهِ.
transliteration: wa a'ūdhu bika yā rabb min hammi al-dīni wa fikrihi wa shughli al-dayni wa sahrihi
english_text: I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, from worry and thought about debt, from the distraction and sleeplessness of debt;

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْهُ.
transliteration: fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa aʿiẓnī minhu
english_text: so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge from it!

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَجيرُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ ذِلَّتِهِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ وَمِنْ تَبِعَتِهِ بَعْدَ الْوَفَاةِ.
transliteration: wa-astaǧīru bika yā rabbī min ẓillatihī fī al-ḥayāh wa min tabiʿatihi baʿda al-wafā'a
english_text: I seek sanctuary in Thee, my Lord, from debt's abasement in life and its ill effects after death,

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ بِوُسْع فاضِل أَوْ كَفَاف وَاصِل.
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ajirnī minhu bi-wusʿin fāḍil aw kafāf waṣil
english_text: so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me sanctuary from it through a bountiful plenty or a continually arriving sufficiency!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاحْجُبْنِي عَنِ السَّرَفِ وَالازْدِيَادِ، وَقَوِّمْنِي بِالْبَذْلِ وَالاقْتِصَـادِ، وَعَلِّمْنِي حُسْنَ التَّقْدِيرِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa aḥjubnī ʿani as-sarafi wal-azdiyād waqawwimni bil-badli wal-iqtisadi wa ʿallimnī ḥusna t-taqdīr
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household prevent me from extravagance and excess, put me on the course of generous spending and moderation, teach me excellent distribution,

arabic_text: وَاقْبِضْنِي بِلُطْفِكَ عَنِ التَّبْذِيرِ وَأَجْرِ مِنْ أَسْبَابِ الْحَلاَلِ أَرْزَاقِي، وَوَجِّهْ فِي أَبْوَابِ الْبِرِّ إنْفَاقِي، وَازْوِ عَنِّي مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُحْدِثُ لِي مَخِيلََةً
transliteration: waqbithni bilutfika 'ani alttabthir wa ajri min asbab al-halal arzaqi wa wajjih fi abwabi al-birr infaqi wa-zwi ʿanni minal māli mā yuḥdithu lī makhīlan
english_text: hold me back through Thy gentleness from squandering, allow me to attain my provisions through lawful means, direct my spending toward the gateways of devotion, and take away from me any possession which will bring forth pride in me,

arabic_text: أَوْ تَأَدِّياً إلَى بَغْي، أَوْ مَا أَتَعَقَّبُ مِنْهُ طُغْيَـاناً.
transliteration: 'aw ta'addiyan ila baghyin, aw ma at'aqqabu minhu tughyanan
english_text: lead to insolence, or drag me in its heels to rebellion!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إلَيَّ صُحْبَـةَ الْفُقَرَاءِ، وَأَعِنِّي عَلَى صُحْبَتِهِمْ بِحُسْنِ الْصَّبْرِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ḥabbib ilayya ṣuḥbat al-fuqarā' wa'aʿinni ʿalā ṣuḥbatihim biḥusni al-ṣabri
english_text: O God, make me love the companionship of the poor and help me be their companion with excellent patience!

arabic_text: وَمَـا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِنْ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَاالفَانِيَةِ فَاذْخَرْهُ لِيْ فِي خَزَائِنِكَ البَاقِيَةِ،
transliteration: wa mā zawayta ʿannī min matāʿid-dunyāl-fāniyah fa'zkhurhu li fi khaza'ini-ka al-baqiyah
english_text: Whenever Thou takest away from me the goods of this perishing world, store them for me in Thy abiding treasuries!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي مِنْ حُطَامِهَا، وَعَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ مَتَاعِهَا بُلْغَةً إلَى جِوَارِكَ، وَوُصْلَةً إلَى قُرْبِكَ، وَذَرِيعَةً إلَى جَنَّتِكَ
transliteration: wajʿal ma khawwaltani min huṭamihā wa'ajjaltali min mata'ihā bulghatan ilā jiwarika wa wuṣlatan ilā qurbika, wa tharīʿatan ilā jannatik
english_text: Make this world's broken pieces which Thou hast conferred upon me and its goods which Thou hast quickly granted to me a way to reach Thy neighbourhood, a link to Thy nearness, and a means to Thy Garden!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ ذو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَأَنْتَ الْجَوَادُ الْكَرِيْمُ.
transliteration: 'innaka dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm wa anta al-jawwad al-karim
english_text: Verily Thou art Possessor of bounty abounding, and Thou art the Munificent, the Generous.
